scatter.anchor_pass: 5/5 judges correct on b5a (0 vs 8, extreme delta) — validates substrate
scatter.ranking: >=4/5 judges correct on each of b5s1, b5s2, b5s3 — scatter is reliably rankable at fixed rotation
scatter.floor: if b5s1 (delta=2) fails but b5s2 (delta=3) passes, perceptual floor is between 2 and 3

rotation.ranking: >=4/5 judges correct on each of b5r1, b5r2, b5r3, b5r4 — rotation is reliably rankable at fixed scatter
rotation.floor: if b5r2 (delta=10 deg) fails but b5r3 (delta=20 deg) passes, perceptual floor is between 10 and 20 deg

cross_factor.scatter_question: >=4/5 judges pick left (high-scatter side) on b5x1 — scatter does not read as rotation
cross_factor.rotation_question: >=4/5 judges pick right (high-rotation side) on b5x2 — rotation does not read as scatter
cross_factor.verdict_rule: both pass -> scatter and rotation are separable, independently judgeable; either fails -> cross-factor confusion above threshold, factors not separable at these deltas

opacity_falloff.extreme: >=4/5 correct on b5o1 (p1) and b5o3 (p2) — fading is detectable at both stroke counts
opacity_falloff.jnd: b5o2 (delta=0.5 at p1) and b5o4 (delta=0.5 at p2) agreement gives the JND; if both fail, JND is above 0.5
opacity_falloff.independence: agreement on b5o1 vs b5o3 and b5o2 vs b5o4 within each other's bootstrap CIs -> opacity_falloff reads independently of stroke count; if p1 pairs pass but p2 pairs fail (or vice versa), opacity_falloff interacts with overlap density

pass_criteria.general: any scored pair with a 50/50 judge split is a stimulus failure, not human noise: regenerate at higher parameter delta in the next batch

adaptive_rules.catch_fail: a judge answering >1 catch pair with a side choice instead of 'no difference' is excluded from aggregates; recruit a replacement to hold n=5
adaptive_rules.scatter_fail: if 0v2 fails but 2v5 passes, floor is between 2 and 5: next batch probes 2v4 and 3v5
adaptive_rules.rotation_fail: if 0v10 fails but 10v30 passes, floor is between 10 and 30 deg: next batch probes 10v20 and 15v25
adaptive_rules.cross_factor_fail: if b5x1 fails (judges pick high-rotation side for scatter question), scatter and rotation are confounded at these deltas: next batch increases scatter delta to 12 and retests; if still fails, factors collapse to composite
adaptive_rules.opacity_fail: if 0v0.5 fails but 0v1.0 passes, JND is between 0.5 and 1.0: next batch probes 0.5v0.75 and 0.6v0.8
adaptive_rules.opacity_independence_fail: if p1 pairs pass but p2 pairs fail, opacity_falloff interacts with stroke count: next batch tests at passes=3 and with explicit overlap density control
adaptive_rules.stimulus_fail: 50/50 splits get regenerated at higher contrast next batch and logged as stimulus-quality data
adaptive_rules.convergence: two consecutive batches with agreement values inside each other's bootstrap CIs at target n ends the loop for that dimension; the plateau is the metric's honest ceiling

registry_consequences.scatter_pass: scatter -> validated as independent mark-making axis (mark_scatter)
registry_consequences.rotation_pass: rotation -> validated as independent mark-making axis (mark_rotation)
registry_consequences.cross_factor_pass: scatter and rotation -> validated as separable, independently judgeable; both promoted to own axes
registry_consequences.cross_factor_fail: scatter and rotation -> collapsed into composite mark_making factor with evidence
registry_consequences.opacity_pass: opacity_falloff -> validated as fading axis, independent of stroke count (opacity_fade)
registry_consequences.opacity_independence_fail: opacity_falloff -> validated as fading but interacts with stroke count; flagged with interaction term
registry_consequences.opacity_fail: opacity_falloff -> stays measurable, JND work queued
